//: Covers the repository-root entrypoints in scripts/ and nothing else.
These four files are what a developer and CI actually invoke, and they import the
workspace packages by name. Until this file existed, `bun run ingest` could carry a
wrong-package import past every package typecheck and every structural gate, because no
tsconfig reached scripts/ at all - the CI runner that gates the repository was itself
ungated. `include` is deliberately narrow: the packages have their own configs, and
